sop_thesis: **Edgewell Personal Care Company (EPC)** operates in Consumer Discretionary (Package Goods/Cosmetics) with an established market capitalization of $1.28B. The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Brand Equity, Omnichannel Logistics Scale & Customer Loyalty. Long-term valuation metrics model an intrinsic DCF fair value of $33.16 (18.0% margin of safety). Systematic tranche entry is recommended at $27.54 (Tranche 1), $25.85 (Tranche 2), and $23.89 (Tranche 3).
